title: Recovery 1.1 - which strap pad is SOP2 (beeper)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: Beeper. Red lead on one strap pad, black lead on U1 pins 21, 34, 35 and 32 in turn; then the next pad. Expected: each pad beeps on exactly one SOP pin and never on pin 32.

callouts.label: strap pad X4, SOP0
callouts.note: The top round pad. Measured: beeps to U1 pin 35 (SOP0), raptox's beeper, unpowered, 2026-11-05. Red lead here.

callouts.label: strap pad X5, SOP1
callouts.note: The middle round pad. Measured: beeps to U1 pin 34 (SOP1), raptox's beeper, unpowered, 2026-11-05. Red lead here.

callouts.label: strap pad X6, SOP2
callouts.note: The bottom round pad. Measured: beeps to U1 pin 21 (SOP2), raptox's beeper, unpowered, 2026-11-05. Red lead here.

callouts.label: U1 pin 21, SOP2
callouts.note: Boot-mode strap SOP2 (SWAS035C table 7-1). Fifth toe from the left on the bottom edge. Black lead here, one after the other.

callouts.label: U1 pin 34, SOP1
callouts.note: Boot-mode strap SOP1 (SWAS035C). Second toe up on the right edge. Black lead here, one after the other.

callouts.label: U1 pin 35, SOP0
callouts.note: Boot-mode strap SOP0 (SWAS035C). Third toe up on the right edge. Black lead here, one after the other.

callouts.label: U1 pin 32, nRESET
callouts.note: Reset, active low (SWAS035C). Rightmost toe of the bottom edge. Black lead here, one after the other.

terminals.label: Meter red lead: X4, then X5, then X6
Meter black lead: U1 pin 21, 34, 35, 32 in turn
